address: 136/1 Soi Yen Akat 2, Chong Nonsi, Yan Nawa, Bangkok, 10120, Thailand
bio: Food and mood pair well at Dutch chef-owner Henk Savelberg’s eponymous restaurant, now in a contemporary house in Chong Nonsi. The sparkling dining room features an open kitchen, a refined wine cellar and garden views, with private group dining available. The menu boasts adventurous, modern, colourful French dishes with a classical base, made from fine international ingredients. Rounding out the experience is the professional service. Booking is essential....
